summary: 24 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • retry: add auto-retry for Copilot provider with terminal failure classification (3b0b866)
  • professions: add CLI availability detection and enablement control for primary professions (901610e)
  • health: add resolved executable path to health status (f1aff7d)
  • autotask: store research vault metadata in structured format (dc42dea)
  • sessions: prefer research vault workspace for code server launch (7743ae0)
  • models: add research output vault metadata reader (b31d383)
  • proposals: add achievement event for review submission (15604db)
  • sessions: record achievement event for auto compose commit (0fad5ef)
  • global-counter: add TokenTotal metric with achievement projection (5087ef0)
  • achievements: deduplicate git ai commit actions in product behavior events (3291137)
  • standard-words: add project standard words management system (a22b836)

HagiCode-org/web

  • statusbar: enhance indicators and health monitoring (c073853)
  • git: improve auto-compose drawer and vault commit UI (4fff69b)
  • session: enhance online duration and achievement displays (b92cb62)
  • hero: enhance profession cards and system settings panel (32c35c8)
  • steam: add Steam image showcase and turbo engine feature lock overlay (612b7c5)
  • layout: add MonoSpec project detection achievement trigger (d24de2d)
  • achievements: add dedicated MonoSpec detection achievement event (2371e44)
  • achievements: add snapshot event bus for achievement synchronization (e760fe5)
  • ui: add query prop support and project words fetching (0a51cba)
  • monospecs: improve path validation and reference handling (dd65411)
  • proposal: add target repositories support for proposal creation (319b0ab)
  • path-reference: add project standard words integration and side submenu layout (8f2b638)
  • project-standard-words: add project standard words API and state management (e5a1e09)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/web

  • achievements: support global-first-experience source kind and stable notification deduplication (bb92e20)
